evidence: src/net_class.h now declares the six real primary methods; the original first four entries at 0x0066EB04 share 0x00404260 and the final two share 0x00404280. Existing source claims at those leaf addresses remain in alphamovie.cpp under catalogue labels. application_binary.select_bindings requires one unambiguous product definition per original entity, so generated-table diagnostics cannot resolve the additional Net method symbols from those existing claims.

The primary table bounds are now source-owned: original Net code dispatches slot 5 at 0x00632612, while the original NetDaemon table at 0x0066EF0C has six relocated executable pointers followed at 0x0066EF24 by an unrelocated non-code word. The zero-offset constructor chain constrains the Net and AlphaNet primary tables to the same six slots. Bounded native checks distinguish the passing NetDaemon table from unresolved Net/AlphaNet folded targets; the daemon callback bodies remain explicit placeholders, not accepted implementations.
payload.hypothesis: Add project-agnostic support for evidence-anchored many-to-one function bindings so distinct C++ methods can share an original folded code body without becoming duplicate recovery identities or adopting another class name. Essential bindings must remain in source; every additional emitted method needs fresh bounded byte/reference proof, and shared original claims must stay protected. Apply this consistently to table/caller resolution, tasks and variant checks rather than adding a Net-specific alias exception. Keep the provisional slot-0 signature and unfinished callback behavior separate from byte-only alias proof.
